sentences.en: I was keen on classical music in my school days.
sentences.zh: 我上学的时候特别喜欢古典音乐。

sentences.en: My school is getting ready for the campus music festival.
sentences.zh: 我们学校正在为校园音乐节做准备。

sentences.en: Who that understands music could say his playing was good?
sentences.zh: 谁懂音乐还能说他弹得不好呢？

senses.zh: 音乐, 乐曲, 乐曲创作（或演奏）艺术, 乐谱
